title: Pac-Man (Classic NES)
sources: own knowledge of the NES original

rows: Chases you directly; speeds up late in a level
Aims four tiles ahead of you
Chases, then wanders off when close

widgets.text: A power pellet turns ghosts blue: eat them for 200/400/800/1600. The blue time gets shorter each level. Ghosts are slower in the side tunnels.
One maze; 240 dots and 4 power pellets. Fruit appears twice per level below the ghost house.
Clearing all four ghosts on every power pellet is where the big scores come from.
Levels repeat with faster ghosts and shorter blue time; the fruit shows the level.
